title: New DATA_LAYER Error Code for CRM Logs
summary: The `CrmlogErrorCode` schema in Application Integration now includes a new `DATA_LAYER` enum value for `commonErrorCode`. This expands the set of identifiable error types for CRM log entries.
details: Developers working with Application Integration's CRM log error codes will find a new enum value, `DATA_LAYER`, added to the `commonErrorCode` property within the `CrmlogErrorCode` schema. This provides more granular error reporting for issues originating from the data layer.
